source_title: What Payment Methods Are Available And How Can I Enable Them For My Product

snippets.snippet_text: "Creators who live in other countries have limited payment methods available to Brazilian Buyers. This is because the commission will be paid in dollars. In addition, payment via bank slip and bank transfer, for example, does not convert on the platform. Therefore, the payment option available on the payment page will be by credit card and PIX."

intake_notes: Hotmart help center article (accessed April 14, 2026; no publication date). Non-Brazil creators selling to Brazil buyers: only credit card and PIX available; bank slip and transfer not supported across currency boundary.
